description: A hub-and-spoke concept diagram of what an ERP is. In the CENTER a large rounded cylinder (a database) labelled 'One shared record' with a smaller line under it 'Rasoi Steel Works'. Around it, evenly spaced on a circle, six rounded rectangles (modules), each joined to the center cylinder by a thin two-way arrow. Their labels, clockwise from top: 'Purchasing', 'Stores', 'Finance', 'Production', 'Sales', 'People and payroll'. Under each module box, one short grey caption: under Purchasing 'requests, orders'; under Stores 'stock, goods received'; under Finance 'invoices, payments'; under Production 'what to make, when'; under Sales 'customers, dispatch'; under People and payroll 'leave, salaries'. The center cylinder is filled light sky blue; module boxes are white with thin grey outlines. Wide 16:9 landscape composition. Labels as plain text, no brackets, spelled exactly as given, no other text.

A left-to-right architecture diagram with five columns joined by arrows. Column 1: a rounded speech box with the text 'Order 20,000 gaskets from Deccan Polymers' and above it a small label 'Kavita types one sentence'. Column 2: a large rounded box filled light sky blue labelled 'Orchestrator LLM' with a smaller line 'chooses the next tool, reads the result, writes the reply'. Column 3: a tall narrow vertical bar labelled 'MCP' with a small caption 'the plug'. Column 4: a rounded panel labelled 'Toolbox' containing five stacked white tool boxes with monospace labels 'check_stock', 'create_purchase_request', 'approve_purchase_request', 'create_purchase_order', 'release_purchase_order', and a small caption under the panel 'one tool per activity: tool.json + tool.py'. Column 5: a rounded box filled light ember orange labelled 'Bahi ERP 7.2' with smaller text 'services, a black box: input in, output out'. Arrows go right from column 1 to 5 along the top labelled 'request', and a return arrow along the bottom from column 5 back to column 1 labelled 'receipt: PO/2026/01182 RELEASED'. Wide 16:9 landscape composition. Labels as plain text, no brackets, spelled exactly as given, no other text.

A concept diagram of one tool. On the LEFT a folder shape labelled 'create_purchase_order/' containing two file cards stacked vertically. The upper file card is labelled 'tool.json' with four short lines inside it in monospace: 'name', 'description', 'input_schema', 'output_schema'. The lower file card is labelled 'tool.py' with one monospace line inside 'def run(s, supplier_code, request_no, confirm)'. In the MIDDLE an arrow from tool.json pointing up-right to a box filled light sky blue labelled 'Orchestrator LLM' with the arrow labelled 'what the model reads'. A second arrow from tool.py pointing right to a box filled light ember orange labelled 'Bahi services' with three small monospace chips inside 'po_fetch', 'po_save', 'po_get', the arrow labelled 'what runs'. On the far RIGHT a small rounded card labelled 'receipt' with two monospace lines 'PO/2026/01182' and 'APPROVED, Rs 2,80,840'. An arrow from Bahi services to the receipt card. Wide 16:9 landscape composition. Labels as plain text, no brackets, spelled exactly as given, no other text.

A two-panel comparison diagram, LEFT panel and RIGHT panel side by side, same height. LEFT panel header 'Before' in ember orange. Inside: a column of nine small grey rectangles shaped like old software windows stacked in a slightly staggered cascade, each with a tiny title bar, labelled top to bottom 'Sign in', 'Item enquiry', 'Stock status', 'Request entry', 'Request approval', 'Order history', 'Order entry', 'Order release', 'Goods receipt'. At the bottom of the left panel a box labelled 'Bahi ERP 7.2'. RIGHT panel header 'After' in sky blue. Inside: one large rounded chat box with three short message lines 'How many gaskets do we have?', 'Raise a request for 20,000', 'Order them from Deccan', then a single arrow down to a box labelled 'Ask Rasoi', then an arrow down to the same box labelled 'Bahi ERP 7.2'. Both panels end at an identical Bahi ERP 7.2 box to show the ERP underneath does not change. Wide 16:9 landscape composition. Labels as plain text, no brackets, spelled exactly as given, no other text.
